opportunities.name: Hotel search, currency conversion, and email proposal
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Booking.com, open a hotel, convert its price from EUR to a target currency on xe.com, then draft an email to a contact proposing the hotel.
steps: On Booking enter destination and check-in/out dates, then Search
On xe.com Currency Converter enter the price as the receiving amount and select the target currency, then Convert
Open mail compose, enter recipient, subject 'Hotel for <city>, <dates>'
Type body with hotel name, price in EUR and converted amount, ask 'OK to book?'

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20, Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South, 818 EUR to USD, maria@example.com

opportunities.name: City weather, local news, and heads-up email
opportunities.description: For a city, look up the 10-day weather forecast, search BBC news for '<city> strike', open an article, and email a contact a summary of the weather and the headline.
steps: On the weather site search for the city and select it
Open the 10 Day forecast and note the day's high/low and condition
On BBC search '<city> strike' and open a relevant article
Compose mail with recipient, subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>'
Type body with weather and the news headline and date

opportunities.name: Visa requirements and holidays note
opportunities.description: For a traveler nationality and destination country, look up the Wikipedia visa requirements page, look up the country's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia for 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens' and find the destination country entry
Go to timeanddate Holidays and open the destination country's holidays
Note the holidays for the relevant month
Add a new note summarizing visa status, stay and holidays
